title: Strict henselization from pointed neighbourhoods
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point]. Let $\mathcal N^{\mathrm{aff}}_{\bar s}$ be the full subcategory of pointed etale neighbourhoods [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods] whose underlying scheme is affine, written $V=\operatorname{Spec}A_V$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-etale-essentially-small-cover] with $T=S$, choose a small full subcategory $\mathcal J_{\bar s}\subset\mathcal N^{\mathrm{aff}}_{\bar s}$ containing one representative of every isomorphism class of pairs $(V,\bar v)$; it is small because the affine etale objects have a set of representatives and each set of lifts $\operatorname{Hom}_S(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,V)$ is a set. Thus every affine pointed neighbourhood is isomorphic to an object of $\mathcal J_{\bar s}$.

Put $\mathcal I_{\bar s}:=\mathcal J_{\bar s}^{\mathrm{op}}$. For $V=\operatorname{Spec}A_V$ define $D_{\bar s}:\mathcal I_{\bar s}\to\mathbf{CRing}$ by $D_{\bar s}(V,\bar v)=A_V$; an arrow represented by a pointed map $a:(V,\bar v)\to(W,\bar w)$ is sent to $a^\#:A_W\to A_V$. Since $\mathcal J_{\bar s}$ is small, the colimit in commutative rings exists by [lem-weil-pbc-commutative-algebras-colimits-exist] and [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Define

$$
 A^{\mathrm{sh}}_{S,\bar s}:=\varinjlim_{\mathcal I_{\bar s}}D_{\bar s},\qquad
 S_{(\bar s)}:=\operatorname{Spec}A^{\mathrm{sh}}_{S,\bar s}.
$$

The category of all pointed etale neighbourhoods is cofiltered by [lem-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods-cofiltered], and its affine full subcategory is initial by [lemma-weil-pbc-affine-neighbourhood-cofinal]; hence [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-initial-full-subcategory](1) gives cofilteredness and independence of the colimit from replacing all affine neighbourhoods by $\mathcal J_{\bar s}$. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-spec-small-colimit-limit] to the small diagram gives canonical maps identifying $S_{(\bar s)}$ with the inverse limit over $\mathcal J_{\bar s}$; transporting this limit along the representative equivalence gives the inverse-limit notation over all affine pointed neighbourhoods, independent up to canonical isomorphism of the choice of $\mathcal J_{\bar s}$.

proof.text: The precomposition functor on elements is faithful because AffineEtale.Spec is faithful. Given a pointed morphism between its images, take the preimage of the underlying etale morphism under the full AffineEtale.Spec functor; its map-preimage identity preserves the point equation. ObjectProperty.lift to the affine full subcategory remains full and faithful. For an affine pointed neighbourhood (V,v), use e = V.isoSpec, put A = AffineEtale.mk (e.inv composed with V.hom), and put y = v composed with e.hom. The equation y composed with A.hom = s follows from the inverse identities for e and v being over S. The iso e.inv over S induces a pointed category-of-elements isomorphism from the image of (A,y) to (V,v). Thus strictHenselizationAffineInclusion is essentially surjective and is an equivalence.

The inverse of equivSmallModel and strictHenselizationAffineInclusion are equivalences, hence initial. The inclusion of all affine pointed neighbourhoods is initial by affinePointedNeighbourhoods_initial_and_final_op. Their composite F is initial and fully faithful. For every pointed neighbourhood X, its costructured-arrow category for F is connected, hence nonempty, providing an arrow F(Y) to X. Since the ambient pointed category is cofiltered, IsCofiltered.of_exists_of_isCofiltered_of_fullyFaithful proves cofilteredness of the small representative category.

The opposite of colimit.isColimit (strictHenselizationDiagram s) is a limit cone in opposite commutative rings. The right-adjoint Scheme.Spec preserves this limit: isLimitOfPreserves Scheme.Spec gives exactly IsLimit (strictHenselizationCone s), whose legs are defined to be Spec of the colimit coprojections. The representative-independence comparison remains HasColimit.isoOfEquivalence e w.

Let

$$
\mathcal I_{\bar s}:=
(\mathcal N^{\mathrm{aff}}_{\bar s})^{\mathrm{op}}.
$$

For $V=\operatorname{Spec}A_V$, define
$D_{\bar s}:\mathcal I_{\bar s}\to\mathbf{CRing}$ by
$D_{\bar s}(V,\bar v)=A_V$. An arrow
$(W,\bar w)\to(V,\bar v)$ in $\mathcal I_{\bar s}$ represented by a pointed
map $a:(V,\bar v)\to(W,\bar w)$ is sent to
$a^\#:A_W\to A_V$. Put

$$
A^{\mathrm{sh}}_{S,\bar s}:=\varinjlim_{\mathcal I_{\bar s}}D_{\bar s},
\qquad
S_{(\bar s)}:=\operatorname{Spec}A^{\mathrm{sh}}_{S,\bar s}.
$$

The affine scheme–ring anti-equivalence carries the colimit cocone to the
canonical limit cone

$$
S_{(\bar s)}\xrightarrow{\sim}
\varprojlim_{(V,\bar v)\in\mathcal N^{\mathrm{aff}}_{\bar s}}V.
$$
